items.q: How do I run Playwright tests in the cloud?
items.a: Add the TestMu AI WebSocket endpoint to connectOptions in playwright.config with your credentials and capabilities, then run as usual.

items.q: Which browsers can I run Playwright tests on?
items.a: Chromium, Chrome, Edge, Firefox and WebKit on Windows and macOS versions.

items.q: Can I run Playwright tests in parallel?
items.a: Yes. Raise workers; each worker uses a parallel session on your plan.

items.q: Is there a free plan for Playwright testing?
items.a: Yes. The automation free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions.
Keep Playwright for coded suites. Use Kane CLI when you want plain-English checks with evidence; see the Kane CLI vs Playwright comparison.
